settings.schema: connection currentSchema of mainDataSource (ace in ACE PostgreSQL profiles); no schemas/defaultSchema/placeholder call (D-RCV-47)
settings.createSchemasNote: set explicitly: Flyway default is true; with false Flyway never creates a schema; a missing currentSchema fails the migrate (D-RCV-48, X12, T-044-03)
settings.baselineNote: as SampleModuleConfig: schema ace is non-empty, so the first recovery migrate writes a baseline row at version 0 and applies V0001 and later; no baseline row on an empty schema (D-RCV-48, T-044-16)

activation.databaseProduct: PostgreSQL only; skipped on H2 outside the migration job (OPEN-007)
activation.dbMigrateWithoutRecovery: profile db-migrate active without db-migrate-recovery -> recovery bean and initializer not created, whatever spring.flyway.enabled says; no flyway_schema_history_recovery or rwb_ object created (D-RCV-45, T-044-15)
activation.localStart: local developer start: spring.flyway.enabled=true and PostgreSQL -> FlywayMigrationInitializer after core initializer when present; no hard @DependsOn

migrationJob.exit: 0 on success; non-zero after logging MSG-P3-016 on FlywayException
migrationJob.image: one image built once; same digest deployed to DEV, SIT, UAT and PROD (OPEN-013 ruling)
migrationJob.missingBeanOrNonPostgres: no skip: log MSG-P3-016 object=recoveryFlyway at ERROR, exit non-zero, migrate nothing (REVIEW-RWB-E1-044-014, T-044-12)
migrationJob.account: migration-job database role already used by the core db-migrate step on schema ace (ACEDbFlywayRole_<ENV>); the recovery step must use the same role so ACE default privileges (db/migration-env/<env>/V001.001__grant_permission.sql) give ACEAppRole_<ENV> DML on rwb_ tables and sequences (OPEN-019 condition); no DBA request (D-RCV-47; OPEN-020 withdrawn)

parameters: schema (connection current schema; omitted for lint)
errorReporting.exception: refused clean shows Flyway's own message (D-RCV-28 (4))

backendOnlyContracts.sequence: unique and contiguous 0001..N, taken at merge (D-RCV-28, D-RCV-34)
backendOnlyContracts.perKey: at most one non-fix file; each fix file needs one non-fix file of the same key with lower seq
forbidden: any schema-qualified object name (only information_schema / pg_catalog reads allowed)
any statement naming a schema (CREATE/ALTER/DROP SCHEMA, SET SCHEMA, AUTHORIZATION)
table, sequence or index identifier without prefix rwb_ in any statement (see objectNames)
GRANT or REVOKE in any statement, including ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES (privileges come from ACE default privileges for the migration-job role; REVIEW-RWB-E1-044-019)
any of the above inside dollar-quoted bodies ($$...$$, $tag$...$tag$), function and DO bodies included
acceptedGap: names inside ordinary single-quoted string literals other than nextval/currval/setval arguments and '...'::regclass (code review)
names given to views, functions, procedures, types, triggers, policies and rules (not listed in D-RCV-47; code review); the tables they read or act on are checked
backendOnlyContracts.enforcedBy: RecoveryMigrationLintTest (unit test in ACE test task; D-RCV-05)

objectNames.appliesTo: every table, sequence and index identifier in any statement: CREATE TABLE/SEQUENCE/INDEX names; RENAME TO targets; named PRIMARY KEY/UNIQUE/EXCLUDE constraints; targets of ALTER TABLE/SEQUENCE/INDEX (any action incl. OWNER TO), DROP TABLE/SEQUENCE/INDEX, TRUNCATE, LOCK, CLUSTER, REINDEX, ANALYZE, VACUUM; COMMENT ON TABLE/COLUMN/SEQUENCE/INDEX and COMMENT ON CONSTRAINT/TRIGGER/POLICY/RULE ... ON; CREATE TRIGGER/POLICY ... ON, CREATE RULE ... TO; REFERENCES, CREATE INDEX ... ON, LIKE, INHERITS, PARTITION OF, INSERT INTO, UPDATE, DELETE FROM, MERGE INTO; every relation in FROM, JOIN, USING; sequence in nextval/currval/setval and '...'::regclass
objectNames.notTableIdentifiers: set-returning function calls in FROM, parenthesised subqueries and VALUES lists, CTE names of the same statement, aliases, column references (table.column)
objectNames.allowList: relations qualified by information_schema or pg_catalog (read-only); unqualified catalog names fail
objectNames.compliantByDerivation: unnamed indexes, unnamed index-backed constraints and implicit serial/identity sequences (PostgreSQL derives rwb_x_pkey, rwb_x_id_seq from the rwb_ table)
objectNames.physicalTableName: rwb_ + table name in Physical Schema v4 / Logical Data Model

beans.recoveryFlywayMigrationInitializer: @Conditional(RecoveryFlywayCondition.RecoveryLocalStartCondition): PG and FE and not profile db-migrate; forces coreFlywayMigrationInitializer first via ObjectProvider when present; no @DependsOn
beans.recoveryMigrateAndExitRunner: @Profile(db-migrate-recovery); not conditional on recoveryFlyway or on MAE; fails fast (exit 1, MSG-P3-016 object=recoveryFlyway) when MAE is not true, the bean is absent or the URL is not PG

planPins.configureFactory: static FluentConfiguration configure(DataSource): all CON-RWB-E1-044-001 settings; tests override only locations
planPins.migrateOrReport: static void migrateOrReport(Flyway, String jdbcUrl): migrate(); on FlywayException report MSG-P3-016 and rethrow; used by initializer, runner and RecoveryFlywayIT
planPins.activationRule: recoveryFlyway iff PG and (DBMR or (FE and not DBM)); initializer iff PG and FE and not DBM; runner iff DBMR; PG = spring.datasource.url starts with jdbc:postgresql:; FE = spring.flyway.enabled=true; DBM = profile db-migrate active; DBMR = profile db-migrate-recovery active; MAE (recovery.flyway.migrate-and-exit=true) is checked only inside the runner (data-model section 3; plan gate REVIEW-RWB-E1-044-028)
planPins.messageSchemaParameter: currentSchema parsed from the JDBC URL string passed to migrateOrReport (spring.datasource.url, or the test URL); omitted when absent; host, user, password never read; omitted for lint
planPins.migrationFolder: not created by this story; first migration story (RWB-E1-042) creates it; lint treats missing as empty
